description: This file contains unit tests for the SugarDateTime class within the SuiteCRM application, verifying methods like get_day_begin, get_day_end, asDb, asDbDate, get_date_str, and get_day_by_index_this_month.

classes.name: SugarDateTimeTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the SugarDateTime class methods within the SuiteCRM context.

methods.name: testget_day_begin
methods.description: Tests that get_day_begin returns a SugarDateTime at midnight of the specified date.

methods.name: testget_day_end
methods.description: Tests that get_day_end returns a SugarDateTime at 23:59:59 of the specified date.

methods.name: testasDb
methods.description: Verifies that asDb returns a correctly formatted datetime string for database storage.

methods.name: testasDbDate
methods.description: Verifies that asDbDate returns a correctly formatted date string for database storage.

methods.name: testget_date_str
methods.description: Checks that get_date_str returns URL-parameter formatted date components.

methods.name: testget_day_by_index_this_month
methods.description: Tests that get_day_by_index_this_month correctly calculates days within the same month.

methods.name: testget_day_by_index_this_monthWithExcessiveValue
methods.description: Tests get_day_by_index_this_month's behavior when given an index exceeding the current month's length, ensuring it advances to subsequent months.
